explication: PathKit is a small Swift library for representing filesystem paths and performing path-related operations. A caller creates or combines a Path, then uses it to inspect or transform paths, perform filesystem changes, read or write contents, or traverse and glob paths. The sampled source shows Foundation-backed filesystem operations and POSIX glob support; unsampled implementations are represented only where the README documents the capability.
